decimalsHelp: Display only; exact stock quantities are preserved. Pieces and seeds default to zero.
title: Inventory
name: Name
unitHelp: The unit cannot change after the first stock movement. Quantities are not converted.
quantityHelp: Use a decimal point and up to 3 decimal places; maximum 999999999.999. Whole numbers for pieces.
archiveHelp: Only items with zero total stock can be archived.
countHelp: Enter the total counted at this location, not the difference. The previous quantity stays in history.

errors.conflict: This item or its stock changed in another session. Reload it before saving.
errors.unitLocked: The unit cannot change after the first movement.
errors.stockRemaining: Empty all location stocks before archiving this item.
errors.skuTaken: This reference is already used by another item.
errors.requestConflict: This operation identifier was already used with different data.
errors.archived: Restore this archived item before recording movements.
errors.insufficientStock: There is not enough stock at the source location.
errors.quantityLimit: The resulting total exceeds the supported quantity limit.
errors.uncertainResult: The result could not be confirmed. Keep this page open and retry the same operation to avoid a duplicate.

validation.nameInvalid: Enter a name of up to 120 characters.
validation.skuInvalid: The reference must not exceed 80 characters.
validation.descriptionInvalid: The description must not exceed 2,000 characters.
validation.quantityInvalid: Enter a nonnegative decimal string with up to 9 integer digits and 3 decimal places, using a point.
validation.wholePieces: Use whole numbers for items counted in pieces.
validation.quantityPositive: Enter a quantity greater than zero. A physical count may be zero.
validation.filterInvalid: Check the search filters and page.
validation.reasonInvalid: Enter a reason of up to 500 characters.
validation.requestInvalid: Reopen the movement form and try again.
validation.locationInvalid: Choose the required existing source and destination locations.
validation.differentLocations: Choose different source and destination locations.
validation.invalid: Check the form fields and try again.
validation.seedUnit: Seeds must be counted in pieces.
validation.linkedSeeds: This stock is linked to a strain. Unlink it before changing its type.
validation.capacityInvalid: Enter a positive capacity in liters, with up to three decimals. The container must be counted in pieces.
validation.doseInvalid: Use a positive dose with up to three decimal places, for a fertilizer measured in ml, L, g or kg.

doseHelp: Prefills stage recipes. Watering quantities follow the water volume and remain editable.
